kind: Browser fixtures, common configuration review and workflow contracts

rows.name: Diagnostics stay read-only and distinguish other pages, disabled rules, overlaps and invalid selectors
URL review rejects unsafe schemes and credentials and masks confidential query values
Shared confirmation is labelled, traps keyboard focus and restores the opener
Targeted reset and undo change only the draft and retain unknown fields and customized arrays
Sequential batch resumes failures without replaying successes and rejects duplicate identities before writes
Batch cancellation stops before the next operation
